paths.description: Homepage and lead-news discovery template; inspected desktop, mobile, preference, performance, security, network and memory conditions.
Representative editorial article/detail template selected from the live lead links.
Fútbol section/listing template representing topical indexes.
Advanced search form and a representative GET query, covering the primary find-content flow.
Deliberately invalid URL to inspect HTTP/navigation recovery state.

findings.summary: The site remains light when the user requests dark mode.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot remains white and the computed root `color-scheme` is `normal`.
findings.suggestedFix: Use `color-scheme: light dark` and preference-driven surface/text tokens with `light-dark()` or `prefers-color-scheme`.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion mode still runs a continuous pulse animation.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched the preference but still found a running `pulse` animation with 1000 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animation inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and stop auto-advance.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference does not trigger a distinct treatment.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast screenshot is visually unchanged, while Lighthouse separately found multiple low-contrast text nodes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `prefers-contrast` and forced-colors adjustments for text, controls, outlines and scrollbars.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly without View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS/DOM probe found no view-transition usage across the MPA homepage and article navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `@view-transition { navigation: auto; }` for same-origin MPA navigation, then name only elements that benefit.

findings.summary: The long news feed has no scroll-state-aware header or progress cue.
findings.evidence: The homepage is 49,514 px tall on mobile, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or scroll timeline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a declarative progress indicator to make position and remaining content legible.

findings.summary: Overlay positioning is hand-authored and fixed rather than anchored.
findings.evidence: The load-time prompt uses a fixed `#gg-alert` with explicit top/left values; no anchor-positioning or popover primitive is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and `position-try-fallbacks` for attached menus and transient prompts.

findings.summary: A push-notification solicitation obscures primary content on every fresh load.
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, article and 404 screenshots all show the same large prompt covering the page before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not show the prompt on load. Ask only after a user gesture and make dismissal immediate and persistent.

findings.summary: The push prompt is an ad-hoc fixed div rather than a semantic dialog/popover.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports zero dialog, popover and details primitives while `#gg-alert` implements custom fixed overlay chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a `<dialog>` for a true modal or `popover="auto"` for transient UI, with native focus and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Advertising and prompts consume a disproportionate share of the first viewport.
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot devotes roughly 350 px to empty ad space before the lead story and overlays a 400 px prompt.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical ad inventory, remove empty reserved ad space above the lead story, and keep prompts out of the content path.

findings.summary: Complex reused modules rely on viewport breakpoints only.
findings.evidence: The loaded CSS contains extensive media queries but the probe found no `@container` usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for cards, carousels and embedded modules that appear in different column widths.

findings.summary: Some controls have no visible keyboard focus and touch targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: Focused menu/account buttons computed to `outline: none`; Lighthouse found a 16 by 12 px Outbrain control.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a visible `:focus-visible` style and enforce at least 24 by 24 CSS px, preferably 44 px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: The lead news content is delayed behind a prompt and a large blank ad slot.
findings.evidence: The page purpose is clear once visible, but the first desktop viewport hides the lead story below empty ad space and the push prompt.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the lead story in the first viewport and postpone monetisation and notification prompts until after content engagement.

findings.summary: Lab LCP misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.2 s and TBT 250 ms; CLS was good at 0.006.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the lead image/text, reduce render-blocking work and defer advertising/analytics until after the critical content.

findings.summary: Script execution creates avoidable blocking work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 248 ms TBT and estimated 992 KiB of unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Split first-party bundles, delay ad-tech initialization, and schedule non-critical work after the critical render.

findings.summary: The critical load is burdened by many scripts, fonts and render-blocking stylesheets.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 134 requests and 3.34 MB transferred, including 53 scripts (2.15 MB), 8 fonts (480 KB), and multiple parser-inserted stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer template-specific styles and third-party scripts, and apply useful caching/preload priority to true LCP resources.

findings.summary: A large share of shipped CSS and JavaScript is unused on the homepage.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 992 KiB unused JS and 58 KiB unused CSS; several bundles are 70 to 100 percent unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and consent state; load ad/account/carousel code only when the corresponding feature is present or activated.

findings.summary: Images and search controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found four image-alt failures; probes found 4 to 5 missing image alts and all seven visible search controls unlabeled.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful `alt` or empty decorative alt, and associate visible `<label>` elements with every search/filter control.

findings.summary: Several text treatments fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found ratios of 4.46, 4.43, 3.25 and as low as 1.72 on article labels, game copy, sponsored labels and footer links.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text and verify third-party widget themes.

findings.summary: Visible focus is removed from important header controls.
findings.evidence: The document has a main landmark and sequential headings, but focused menu/account buttons compute to `outline: none`.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a consistent, high-contrast `:focus-visible` ring and preserve logical DOM/reading order.

findings.summary: Touch targets and media alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Viewport zoom is allowed, but Lighthouse found an undersized 16 by 12 px control and the homepage probe found 10 video elements with no track elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase small targets, retain unrestricted zoom, and provide captions/transcripts for editorial video when speech is present.

findings.summary: The homepage logs advertising exceptions and a failed localhost request.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured two GPT TypeErrors and `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` for localhost.sensic.net.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard GPT configuration access, remove the invalid localhost Sensic endpoint, and keep third-party failures from reaching the console.

findings.summary: Many images omit intrinsic dimensions and modern responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 39 missing dimensions, 62 missing srcsets and 97 legacy-format images on the sampled homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and use `<picture>`/`srcset` with modern formats.

findings.summary: Core transport defenses and cookie flags are missing.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; all 13 sampled cookies lack Secure and many use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, CSP and nosniff; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure and use the narrowest suitable SameSite value.

findings.summary: The page has an exceptionally broad tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 47 third-party origins and 8 known tracker domains; HAR attributes 128 requests and 2.91 MB to non-main origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential vendors behind explicit consent, consolidate analytics, and remove vendors that do not provide measurable user value.

findings.summary: The visible account entry point has no detectable phishing-resistant authentication path.
findings.evidence: No permission request was detected on load, but the account/auth probe found no WebAuthn or `navigator.credentials` integration.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in and registration alongside recovery-safe alternatives; keep permission requests behind user gestures.

findings.summary: Most browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Only X-Frame-Options is present; CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, HSTS, CSP `frame-ancestors`, and Trusted Types where DOM XSS risk justifies it.

findings.summary: The multilingual site is not prepared for bidirectional layout.
findings.evidence: The Spanish `lang` is correct and EN/USA variants exist, but root `dir` is absent and the loaded CSS probe found no logical-property usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Set `dir` appropriately per locale and replace physical left/right spacing and positioning with logical properties.

findings.summary: The notification prompt uses nagging and asymmetric choices.
findings.evidence: Every fresh path shows the same blocking prompt with a green “Sí, acepto” and muted “Ahora no”, while trackers and cookies are already active.
findings.suggestedFix: Ask only in context after demonstrated interest, use equally clear accept/decline choices, persist dismissal, and avoid pre-consent tracking.

findings.summary: Image delivery is dominated by legacy formats and lacks responsive variants.
findings.evidence: The homepage image audit reports 97 legacy-format images, 62 missing srcsets and 39 missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and `srcset`/`sizes`, retaining intrinsic dimensions and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Large amounts of advertising and analytics code run before user demand.
findings.evidence: HAR records 53 scripts and 2.15 MB of script transfer; Lighthouse estimates 992 KiB of JavaScript unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer background vendors until consent and idle time, batch analytics, and remove duplicate tag-manager/ad stacks.

findings.summary: Third-party resources dominate the page budget.
findings.evidence: Third-party traffic accounts for 128 of 134 requests and 2.91 MB of the 3.34 MB transfer total.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, lazy-load non-critical widgets, and enforce vendor budgets in release checks.

findings.summary: Repeated full-feed traversal leaves substantial retained growth.
findings.evidence: After ten bottom/top traversals, heap graph nodes increased from 799,475 to 893,083 and self size from 47.58 MB to 51.34 MB. Lazy loading is a confounder, so confidence is medium.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the repeated scroll cycle by vendor/component, tear down observers/listeners/ad slots, and verify a post-GC plateau over multiple cycles.

findings.summary: The initial homepage memory footprint is heavy for a reading surface.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 799,475 graph nodes and 47.58 MB self size; the live DOM probe counts 3,493 elements before deep interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce initial DOM and scripts, virtualise/defer deep-feed modules, and initialise third-party widgets only near visibility.
